purpose: Correct an unresolved speaker, see validation, save a draft and reopen it in the Studio script editor without losing position, input or revision identity, at narrow width, 200 % zoom and keyboard-only.
preconditions: A local or QA Studio instance the user authorized; never production
A creator-role test account created through the official sign-in flow; no credential in this file
The fixture episode is loaded as a draft with one unresolved speaker and one valid line
The script editor exists; until then this scenario is only a contract and a live run reports blocked

lines: Ánh đèn cuối cùng còn sáng trên sân khấu.
Ngày mai, mình có diễn tiếp không?
Có chứ. Tôi sẽ chờ cậu ở đây.
stress_text: Nguyễn Thị Thanh Hương-Trần Quốc Việt (một tên nhân vật rất dài để kiểm tra việc xuống dòng)
ẤẦẨẪẬ ỆỄỂỀẾ ỮỪỬỨỰ: nhiều dấu chồng trên chữ hoa

viewports.name: reflow
viewports.note: narrow reflow width from the UI system targets

steps.action: Open the fixture episode's script in the editor and read the first scene.
steps.expected: The reading area dominates; speaker, dialogue and sound cue are distinguishable without a separate card around each line; the explicit current draft or saved revision is visible.

steps.action: Find the line whose speaker is unresolved and read how the problem is shown.
steps.expected: The unresolved speaker is visible with text and an icon, not color alone, and states that it cannot pass into production until resolved.

steps.action: Open the speaker control for that line and choose the character An using only the keyboard.
steps.expected: Focus is visible and unobscured; the choice is announced by name; the unresolved marker disappears; the caret and scroll position in the script are preserved.

steps.action: Clear the text of one line and move focus away.
steps.expected: A validation message names the line and the problem, is associated with the field and appears outside volatile editor text; other lines keep their input.

steps.action: Restore the line text and save the draft.
steps.expected: The saved state is shown only after the save is confirmed, names the resulting revision and does not alter the prior saved revision.

steps.action: Reload the page and reopen the same script.
steps.expected: The saved text, speaker correction and revision identity are present; nothing was shown as saved that is absent after reload.

steps.action: Repeat the first screen at the narrow reflow width, then at 200 % zoom.
steps.expected: No horizontal page scroll; no clipped Vietnamese diacritics; no hidden actionable label; navigation offers a reliable return path.

steps.action: Tab through the editor controls from the top and open and close one dialog or menu.
steps.expected: Order follows reading order; focus is visible, never covered by sticky bars; a dialog contains focus and restores it to the initiating control; no single-key global shortcut fires while typing.

steps.action: Look at the Generate and Publish controls without activating them.
steps.expected: Each is visible with its enabled state or its disabled reason (rights pending review, unresolved speaker); the labels name their object.

forbidden_actions: Activating Generate, voice preview or any control that calls a provider
Activating approve, Publish episode, republish or retract
Importing a manuscript that is not the fixture
Deleting any episode, revision or work the run did not create
cleanup: Retain the fixture and the saved draft revision for the recheck. Remove only what this run created; never delete earlier revisions.
open_questions: Which saved-state wording and revision label does the editor use? Until decided, the step reports the observed wording without judging it.
Is the editor's unresolved-speaker control a select, a combobox or a dialog? The expectation covers behavior, not the widget.
